name: Triumph of Saint Katherine
oracle_text:
Lifelink
Praesidium Protectiva — When this creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and the top six cards of your library in a face-down pile. If you do, shuffle that pile and put it back on top of your library.
Miracle {1}{W} (You may cast this card for its miracle cost when you draw it if it's the first card you drew this turn.)
blocked_sentences: Praesidium Protectiva — When this creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and the top six cards of your library in a face-down pile. If you do, shuffle that pile and put it back on top of your library.

needs.what: a `random_order` option on `put_on_top` (top of library, not bottom) that places a bound set of cards -- here the dying card plus the top six cards of its owner's library, exiled face down together as one pile with an `as` binding, gated on 'if you do' -- back on top of the library in a random order, so neither player learns the order. Sibling of `random_order_bottom` (Endurance); one `random_order` flag honouring both `bottom: true` and the default top would close both.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `put_on_top` (op_put_on_top in ops_cards.py) offers only `any_order` (the owner chooses, so they would know where the miracle card sits) or pool order; `look_at_top` can exile the six face down with `as` but has no random-order return to the top, and a `shuffle` op afterwards would randomise the whole library instead of only the seven-card pile.
